verses.1: And these are the judgments that you must face.
verses.2: For if you hire a foreign servant, he will serve for six years. After that, in the seventh year, he must leave to find his own place to live.
verses.3: If he comes with his feet, then he will go out with his feet. If a man marries a woman, then his wife will also go out with him.
verses.4: If Adonai gives him a wife, and she gives birth to sons or daughters, then those children will be the property of Adonai. And he will go away with his own feet.
verses.5: And if the servant says, “I loved my master, my wife, and my children,” then I will not go away in search of another master.
verses.6: And Adonai presented it to the God. He also presented it to the door or to the aperture. Then Adonai touched his ear with that aperture, and he served Him forever.
verses.7: And if a man sells his daughter to another man, she shall not go away as the slaves do.
verses.8: If there is any harm in her eyes, which she intended to give to the foreign people as a gift, then she shall not be able to sell it by deception.
verses.9: And if his heart is destined for us, then it will be done according to the judgment of those who have built.
verses.10: And if he takes her as a wife, then her value and status shall not be diminished.
verses.11: And if these three things are not done for her, then she will be left without any money.
verses.12: Whoever slays another person dies as well.
verses.13: And since it wasn’t possible for me to do so, God gave me the opportunity. I’ve placed you in a place where you can rest in peace.
verses.14: And if one man kills another man in a quarrel, with the help of idols, they will surely be taken to death.
verses.15: And his father and mother died.
verses.16: And if a man commits robbery and selling, and he is found with the dead body in his hands…
verses.17: And his father and mother wept bitterly when they heard the news of his death.
verses.18: And when people fight with each other, and one person hits his neighbor with a stone or a stick, they may not die right away; they can still fall into a pit.
verses.19: If he rises and walks away from his resting place, then the scoffer will give him rest and heal him.
verses.20: And if anyone slays his servant or his beloved one in battle, and they die under his hands, then he will be punished.
verses.21: But if one day or several days pass without him standing up, then his position will be lost.
verses.22: And when men were killed and a virgin woman was raped, and her children were taken away from her, there would be no punishment for those who committed this crime. They would not be punished as the husband of the woman deserved to be punished.
verses.23: And if Asun befalls, and a soul is given one under another’s skin.
verses.24: Eye under eye, shadow under shadow; hand under hand, foot under foot.
verses.25: Under pain, under suffering; under sorrow, under grief.
verses.26: And if anyone were to hurt the eye of his servant, or the eye of his beloved, then he will send us away under his eyes.
verses.27: And if his servant or his true follower falls into the hands of those who seek to harm him, I will send them under his control.
verses.28: And when a man or woman dies, their body will be buried. But their flesh will not be eaten. And the husband of the dead person will be punished.
verses.29: And if the slave is rebellious, then he will be punished along with his master. He will not be spared; both he and his master will die.
verses.30: If a goat is placed upon it, and it gives its life as a sacrifice, just as any other animal that is placed upon it does.
verses.31: Whether it’s a boy or a girl, this judgment will be applied to him/her.
verses.32: If a slave breaks the vessel or the money, he shall give thirty shekels to his master. Then the vessel can be repaired.
verses.33: And if someone opens a hole in it, or if someone tries to repair that hole, but fails to do so, then the hole will fall apart, either in winter or in summer.
verses.34: The owner of the house will be compensated with money, and he will be able to return to his owner. The dead person will also be given back to him.
verses.35: And when one person’s rope is cut by his enemy, he dies. Then, the living rope is sold, and both the dead person and their possessions are divided among those who are alive.
verses.36: Or do we know that Shor Nagah is a fool? He won’t keep us safe under his protection. Shor will be destroyed, and the dead will be left behind.
verses.37: For if a man steals a sheep or a goat, and sells it or trades it, he shall pay five shekels under the law regarding sheep. And four lambs he shall pay under the law regarding goats.
